notes: Four distinct localized manipulation episodes are visible: one food drawer, two separately operated upper-cabinet doors, and one utensil drawer. The initial and final kitchen traversals are not counted.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a wide food-storage drawer, separately opens and closes both hinged doors of an upper cabinet above the stove, and finally opens and closes a narrow utensil/foil drawer beside the stove.
